title: 第十九章顾长青想要自我了断第二十章麻烦又上门身份地位的重要性
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
第二天，天色刚刚破晓，顾晦就起床了。
他只睡了两个小时不到，也就是一个时辰的样子，起床的时候却也没有感到困倦，迷糊片刻，也就神清气爽。
年轻真好！
当然，也和修炼的功法有关，修炼到了极限的确累，但是，只要睡两个小时便能恢复！
顾瑜还在睡觉。
厨房那边传来了声音。
除了锅碗瓢盆的声音之外，还有说话声。
不但母亲徐翠娘起床了，父亲顾长青也起了床，他们声音压得很低，顾晦却也听得清楚。
“孩子他妈，辛苦你了！”
“我留了个册子，借出去的银子有多少，是谁借的，都记在了册子上面……”
“顾晦现在懂事了，有些事情，可以和他商量，听取他的意见，他爷爷那边还是要走动一二，脸皮厚一点，该帮衬的一定要找他帮衬……”
“顾瑜……”
一向沉默的父亲此时却很啰嗦，像是在交代后事。
“当家的，我不知道你在说啥！”
“这些事情，等你好了，你自己亲自处理……”
母亲的声音突然拔高。
“翠娘啊！”
顾长青一声叹息。
顾晦的心往下一沉，他穿衣走了出去。
娘亲在厨房忙活，父亲坐在檐廊的椅子上，身上搭着薄被，神情恍惚，失魂落魄。

瞧见顾晦出来，他脸上勉强挤出笑意，说道：“顾晦，昨晚练得很晚，今天怎么起这么早，还睡一会吧？”
“睡不着了！”
“我练练刀法！”
顾晦朝顾长青笑了笑。
他来到院子中间，抽出猎刀。
“父亲，正好你也在，帮我看看，有没有什么练得不对的地方，指点我一二……”
他望向顾长青，笑着说道。
“好！”
顾长青点点头。
顾晦深吸一口气，身形一闪，跨步向前，挥刀斜劈，血战八式走起……
刀光如雪，闪电来回。
不多会，顾晦收刀入鞘。
八招配合身法步伐的基本刀法很快就演练完毕，这时候，面板出现，一行字浮现出来。
【技能：血战八式（精通）】
【进度，（12100）】
顾晦隐藏了实力，不曾激荡气血，即便如此，身法和步伐比起以前也都厉害了许多，他能够感觉得到，自己对手中的刀有着更稳更强的掌控。
刀就像是延伸出去的手。
content_en:
The next day, just after dawn, Gu Hui got up.
He only slept for less than two hours, which was about an hour, but he didn't feel sleepy when he got up. He felt refreshed after being dazed for a while.
It’s great to be young!
Of course, it also has something to do with the cultivation techniques. It is indeed tiring to practice to the limit, but you can recover as long as you sleep for two hours!
Gu Yu is still sleeping.
A voice came from the kitchen.
In addition to the sounds of pots and pans, there were voices.
Not only mother Xu Cuiniang got up, but father Gu Changqing also got up. Their voices were very low, but Gu Hui could hear them clearly.
"My dear, thank you for your hard work!"
"I kept a book. The amount of money lent and who borrowed it were all recorded in the book..."
"Gu Hui is sensible now. You can discuss some things with him and listen to his opinions. His grandfather still needs to move around and be thick-skinned. If you need help, you must ask him for help..."
"Gu Yu..."
The usually silent father was now very verbose, as if he was explaining the funeral arrangements.
"Master, I don't know what you are talking about!"
"When you get better, you can handle these things yourself..."
The mother's voice suddenly rose in pitch.
"Cui Niang!"
Gu Changqing sighed.
Gu Hui's heart sank, he got dressed and walked out.
My mother was busy in the kitchen, and my father was sitting on a chair on the verandah, with a thin quilt draped over him, looking in a trance and lost his mind.
Seeing Gu Hui come out, he forced a smile on his face and said, "Gu Hui, you practiced very late last night. Why did you get up so early today? You should sleep for a while?"
"Can't sleep!"
"I'll practice my sword skills!"
Gu Hui smiled at Gu Changqing.
He came to the middle of the yard and drew his hunting knife.
"Father, you happen to be here too. Please help me see if there is anything wrong with my practice. Give me some pointers..."
He looked at Gu Changqing and said with a smile.
"Okay!"
Gu Changqing nodded.
Gu Hui took a deep breath, dodged his figure, stepped forward, slashed diagonally with his sword, and walked in the eight bloody fighting postures...
The light of the sword is like snow, and lightning comes and goes.
After a while, Gu Hui sheathed the sword.
The basic sword technique of eight moves combined with body movements and steps was quickly completed. At this time, the panel appeared and a line of words appeared.
[Skill: Eight Styles of Bloody Fighting (Mastery)]
[Progress, (12100)]
Gu Hui hid his strength and never stirred up his energy and blood. Even so, his movement and pace were much better than before. He could feel that he had a more stable and stronger control over the knife in his hand.
The knife is like an extended hand.
